executive_summary.status: Phase 33 comprehensive velocity forensic audit completed across 30 authentic blackout windows and canonical synthetic tests
executive_summary.authentic_data_status: Acquired, verified, and segmented across 72 drives (~29.74 hours, 1,070,745 rows)
executive_summary.ai_velocity_model_status: Frozen VelocityEstimatorNet verified; high quality on straight/low-speed (MAE 2.93 m/s, r=0.729), degraded on cornering (r=-0.026) and high-speed bias (-5.82 m/s). Perfect speed diagnostic proves speed alone does not cause >100% drift (153.4% median drift even with GT speed)
executive_summary.navigation_engine_status: Identified 67.7% of position error stems from 3D attitude tilt leaking gravity into horizontal velocity. Fixed ZARU and gravity-leveling Jacobian sign bugs, improving baseline drift from 148.7% to 132.6%
executive_summary.motorcycle_validation_status: Kinematic roll-lean profile modeled; physical two-wheeler telemetry collection pending
executive_summary.sih_drift_target_status: SIH <10% drift target NOT yet achieved; next intervention must bound dynamic pitch/roll tilt drift to prevent gravity leakage
